units.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising state control (supervision) in the field of production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 14.6 (with respect to regulation of prices for ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products), parts 2.1 and 3 of Article 14.16, Articles 14.17.3 and 14.19, parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43, Articles 14.44 - 14.46, parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2, Article 15.13, part 6 of Article 19.4, and part 22 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.50

units.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.50

units.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.50

units.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising state control (supervision) in the field of production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.50

units.locator: Article 23.50. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Production and Circulation of Ethyl Alcohol, Alcoholic Products and Alcohol-Containing Products
units.text: 3) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising state control (supervision) in the field of production and circulation of ethyl alcohol, alcoholic products and alcohol-containing products with respect to the retail sale of alcoholic products, and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.50

units.locator: Article 23.50.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Sale of Non-Alcoholic Tonic Beverages (Including Energy Drinks)
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of sale of non-alcoholic tonic beverages (including energy drinks) shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.16.1 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.50.1

units.locator: Article 23.50.1. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Sale of Non-Alcoholic Tonic Beverages (Including Energy Drinks)
units.text: 2. Heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of sale of non-alcoholic tonic beverages (including energy drinks) and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.

units.text: 1. Authorities exercising state control (supervision) in the field of state-regulated prices (tariffs) shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 9.15, part 10 (with respect to administrative offences committed by organisations carrying out regulated types of activity) of Article 9.16, part 4 of Article 14.4.2, Article 14.6, part 5 of Article 19.5, Article 19.7.1, and part 1 of Article 19.8.1 (with respect to administrative offences committed by natural monopoly entities and/or municipal solid waste management operators, regional municipal solid waste management operators and/or heat supply organisations) of this Code.

units.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:

units.locator: Article 23.51. Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) in the Field of State-Regulated Prices (Tariffs)

units.text: 3) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of state-regulated prices (tariffs) and their deputies.

units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.52

units.locator: Article 23.52. Federal Executive Authorities Exercising State Control (Supervision) of Compliance with Mandatory Product Requirements and/or Federal State Metrological Supervision

units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.53

units.locator: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording

units.locator: Article 23.53. Federal Executive Authority Carrying Out Official Statistical Recording and Control in the Sphere of Official Statistical Recording
units.text: 2) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority carrying out official statistical recording and control in the sphere of official statistical recording in constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and their deputies.

units.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state housing supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 6.24 (with respect to tobacco smoking in lifts and common-use premises of apartment buildings), Articles 7.21 - 7.23, part 1 of Article 7.23.2, Articles 7.23.3 and 9.5.1, Article 9.13 (with respect to evasion of compliance with requirements to ensure accessibility for persons with disabilities of housing stock facilities), parts 4 and 5, part 12 (with respect to collective (building-wide), individual and shared (for communal apartments) meters for energy resources used in apartment buildings and residential houses) and part 13 (with respect to collective (building-wide), individual and shared (for communal apartments) electricity meters in apartment buildings and residential houses) of Article 9.16, parts 1 - 4 of Article 9.23, part 8 of Article 9.24, part 1 of Article 13.19.2 (except administrative offences committed by housing construction cooperatives constructing apartment buildings), and Article 14.1.3 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.55

units.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.55

units.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision
units.text: 1) chief state housing inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.55

units.locator: Article 23.55. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Housing Supervision
units.text: 2) chief state housing inspectors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for cities and districts and their deputies.
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.55

units.locator: Article 23.58. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Geodesy and Cartography
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of geodesy and cartography shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to points of state geodetic networks, failure to give notice of their destruction or damage, and refusal to provide vehicular or pedestrian access to them), and Articles 7.25, 7.26 and 19.10 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.58
